Hello Tessa / Marissa / Elena,

Thanks for the details and the attachments. We've located a duplicate supplier profile that is preventing the tenant claim from completing. Ticket CH-98923 has been opened for an account reassignment.

What we need from PaperTrail Logistics to proceed:
- A signed Letter of Authorization (LOA) from an authorized signatory on company letterhead (see attached loa-template.pdf).
- Confirmation of the DUNS number for the supplier entity.
- If the user accepted the claim via SSO, please provide the IdP name and IdP-initiated SSO logs if available.

Once we receive the LOA and DUNS confirmation we can reassign the supplier profile to the correct tenant and provide a new activation link. Expect ~24-48 hours SLA after documents are verified.

Support link: https://support.coupa.com/ticket/CH-98923

If you prefer, we can accept the LOA via a secure DocuSign link — let us know and we'll generate one. Please do not include bank account numbers in email attachments; use our secure upload (instructions in the ticket).

Regards,
Coupa Support Team
